_how_the_pin_was_chosen: D8-identity.md's header states a commit count per corpus (6,286 / 2,623 / 1,848). The pin is the commit on the default branch's first-parent chain at which `git rev-list --count HEAD` equals that number. All three matched exactly, which is why the control arm reproduces D8 line for line. Note that this places D8's run in 2026, not 2025 as the experiment files' mtimes suggest.
